name: Article 370 Abrogation (2019)
description: Revocation of Jammu & Kashmir's special status and bifurcation into two Union Territories. Framed as strategic culmination of counter-terrorism doctrine — integrating Kashmir fully into Indian Union.

actions.article_370: Revoked via Presidential Order; J&K special status ended
actions.bifurcation: J&K split into Jammu & Kashmir (UT with legislature) and Ladakh (UT without legislature)

preparation.amarnath_yatra: Cancelled citing security; troop build-up masked
preparation.political_leaders: Omar Abdullah, Mehbooba Mufti placed under house arrest
preparation.communications: Internet, mobile, landline blocked; media restrictions

strategic_rationale.integration: Full constitutional integration; uniform application of laws
strategic_rationale.counter_terror: Remove 'special status' ambiguity used by separatists
strategic_rationale.pakistani_response: Downgraded diplomatic relations; approached UNSC (no action)

film_relevance.part_3: Triumphal closer; Sanyal/Doval strategic culmination; 'Naya Bharat' realization
